name: export-ubl-to-vim
summary: Invoice -> UBL 2.1 XML with the original document embedded as base64, POSTed as a multipart form part through an SAP API gateway to the OpenText VIM inbound endpoint; sent XML archived as a document_relation; VIM's ingest reference written back. Defends against the gateway's SQL threat-protection false positives.

relation_key.description: document_relation key under which the sent XML is archived on the annotation (updated in place on re-export)

export_target_field.description: routing schema id; the hook proceeds when its value is 'sap' or the field is absent from the queue

company_code_field.description: schema id carrying the SAP company code (BUKRS) -> cbc:BuyerReference and the customer party id; lets one hook serve every SAP queue

vim_reference_field.description: write-back schema id for VIM's ingest reference (regid / guid); data-type string field

issue_date_field.description: schema id -> cbc:IssueDate / cbc:TaxPointDate; prefer the reviewer-corrected export variant

document_type_field.description: schema id; credit_note / credit_memo -> InvoiceTypeCode 381 and positive amounts

po_number_field.description: schema id of the matched SAP PO -> cac:OrderReference

supplier_number_field.description: schema id of the matched SAP vendor number (LIFNR) -> PartyIdentification schemeID SAP-LIFNR

supplier_name_field.description: schema id of the supplier name (matched master / PO vendor first, page capture as fallback)

payment_terms_code_field.description: schema id of the SAP payment-terms key (ZTERM) from the matched PO header -> cac:PaymentTerms note

net_field.description: schema id of the header net -> LineExtensionAmount / TaxExclusiveAmount / TaxableAmount

tax_field.description: schema id of the header tax -> TaxAmount

total_field.description: schema id of the header gross -> TaxInclusiveAmount / PayableAmount

line_items_field.description: schema id of the line-item multivalue

line_uom_field.description: line schema id -> unitCode (from the matched PO line); PC when empty

line_price_field.description: line schema id of the unit price; re-derived from net/quantity when it does not reconcile

line_amount_field.description: line schema id of the line net -> cbc:LineExtensionAmount (authoritative)

line_po_item_field.description: line schema id of the matched SAP PO item -> OrderLineReference/LineID

line_tax_code_field.description: line schema id of the SAP tax code -> ClassifiedTaxCategory/ID (ships EMPTY, never omitted, when blank)

provenance: Lifted from a production export hook (2026-06 to 2026-09) sending native-SAP-PO invoices from every company-code queue of one implementation to OpenText VIM through an SAP BTP API gateway; VIM answered 200 COMPLETED/REGISTERED on live documents including TIF originals. The gateway defences each trace to a real 403 (base64 'drop', a filename containing ' or ', an XML comment containing 'or'). Generalized here - the customer's field-level flags (VAT registration, tax rates, due date, bank details, one-time-vendor rules) and its second-target routing are deliberately NOT carried, and the fragment has not been run in this form - hence candidate.
notes: VIM's inbound mapping reads PATHS, so a mapped element must always be present: withhold a value by shipping the element EMPTY (cbc:ID, cbc:CompanyID), except xsd:decimal/date elements (cbc:Percent, cbc:DueDate) where empty is schema-invalid and omission is the only option. The DP number AP works with is NOT in the ingest response - regid/guid get you to the ingested document only. Do not set a request Content-Type: the multipart boundary must come from `requests`. sap-client is mandatory on every SAP API and apiKey on the ingest route; both are QUERY parameters. Keep header cbc:Note to the Rossum annotation id - it is the traceback AP uses.
